articles.summary: When customers see "Currently unavailable" on your Uber Eats listing, your store is paused - not delisted. Uber's published guidance documents three ways it happens automatically: multiple orders in a row going unaccepted, signals that the store is too busy or unavailable to take orders, and a delivery person reporting your store closed followed by a missed confirmation call. Resuming takes seconds from the tablet's Paused bar or the Uber Eats Manager app - and if nobody acts, an automatic pause lifts by 6:00am the next day, which means the platform's failsafe assumes you can afford to lose the rest of today. Prevention is configuration plus discipline; at multi-unit scale, it's automated monitoring, because two platforms times every location is too many pause surfaces to watch by hand.
articles.title: Uber Eats Store "Currently Unavailable"? Why It Happens and How to Fix It
